Sunday night
Madhav came home upset. He'd refused to lend his cricket bat to the neighbour's boy because "he never gives me his ball". He was so sure he was right.

"How did that feel?"
"Bad." He went quiet.
After dinner he took the bat downstairs. I didn't ask him to.
Writing this so I remember: ask about feelings, don't preach.
– Hemant
